name: glorifier-universal-interoperability
description: Discover, normalize, and plan governed interoperability across AI providers, plugins, MCP, A2A, APIs, SDKs, and services.
author: GLORIFIER

interface.longDescription: Evidence-first discovery and integration planning across plugins, AI providers, MCP, A2A agents, APIs, language SDKs, databases, and developer tools. This skills-only package does not automatically connect services or grant access. Live interoperability must be verified for each configured integration.
capabilities: Inventory plugins, AI providers, agents, APIs, and developer tools
Normalize integration capabilities and protocol versions
Plan MCP, A2A, HTTP/OpenAPI, and SDK conformance tests
Identify security, authorization, and evidence gaps
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit an integration inventory and build an evidence-backed interoperability plan.
